scope: Local maintenance of the rich-trace runtime launched by the editor
cause: Synchronized undo snapshot stalled in the old GDB stop loop. An RSP request timed out, the client closed its connection, and disconnect cleared the halt, allowing the load to finish and the game to run without debugger control.

native.framework: C++ and ares CMake/CTest with run-tests.sh; assertions enabled after nall headers
native.configuration: macOS arm64, Ninja RelWithDebInfo, SFC performance profile, both PPU implementations

before.failure: FAIL: paused serialization cannot reach its safe point

coverage: Stable registers and CPU clocks while saving
Step and continue to retained breakpoint

desktop.driver: Actual Tools menu through computer-use UI tools plus C++ TCP RSP client

before.operation: Tools > Load State > Slot 1 while attached and paused at 008000
before.note: Load always serializes the undo snapshot before checking the slot file, so this takes the same blocking path as loading an existing state.
before.result: RSP response timed out after 1500 ms; client closed; desktop logged GDB client disconnected then Failed to load state from slot 1

subsequentControl: Rich trace detail read remains active

limits: The editor process itself was not automated; the same RSP control behavior was checked against the actual desktop over TCP.
No Node was used for the added tests or packaging.
This maintains the older rich-trace runtime; it does not promote the U1-U6 fixture stack or implement U7.
